answer: In a decentralized economy of AI agents, plume-based Sybil resistance mechanisms are employed. Each agent is assigned a unique cryptographic plume that functions as a digital identity. At initialization, agents must prove their authenticity by broadcasting their plume in the network tundra. Forgery is costly; an attacker attempting to generate a large number of fake identities would face exponentially increasing ripple effects, signaling the network and ensuring that anomalous activity is swiftly isolated and neutralized.
